description: Bounded MVP acceptance cases; implemented unit contracts are not claims of real B-rep or Blender UI coverage.
id_policy: Case IDs are permanent. Do not renumber on sorting or reclassification. Retired cases retain an alias/replacement record.

sources.title: OCCT TNaming_Evolution: split, merge and delete semantics

cases.title: Dimension edits preserve supported semantic roles
cases.minimal_fixture: Rectangle from (0,0) to (40,30) mm, extruded +Z by 5 mm. Select cap.end and side.x_min by stable feature UUID and role.
cases.mutation: Change extrusion height 5 to 8 mm, then rectangle width 40 to 50 mm, keeping feature and profile-boundary IDs.
acceptance: References resolve to the same semantic roles despite new local face IDs, areas and centroids.
Real B-rep is valid and volumes progress 6000, 9600, 12000 mm^3.
The saved reference does not change; no inferred geometry match is accepted.
cases.repair_policy: If the adapter cannot establish stable provenance, stop the dependent operation and display evidence rather than assuming the nearest face.

tests.scope: Real construction role provenance across width/height edits.
Real document replay and resolver cap identity across parameter changes.
Real dimensional edit affects mass and mesh; exact fixture differs from the minimal acceptance specimen.

cases.title: Enumeration and display names never define identity
cases.minimal_fixture: Extruded rectangular plate with a reference to cap.end.
cases.mutation: Reverse candidate order, rebuild with fresh face IDs, rename the feature, and save/reload the document.
acceptance: The feature UUID and reference UUID survive rename and serialization.
The selected role remains cap.end regardless of enumeration.
Duplicate snapshot IDs are rejected as invalid adapter output.
cases.repair_policy: Never persist or repair a selection using face-list index, Blender polygon index or a kernel handle.

tests.scope: Canonical source persistence, not saved topology selection persistence.
Stable feature IDs through immutable document edit.
Generated and split handles are deterministic for identical replay but explicitly snapshot-only, never persisted identity.

cases.title: One source face splits into multiple descendants
cases.minimal_fixture: 40 x 30 x 5 mm rectangular plate; select its top face. Cutting box spans x=19..21, y=-1..31, z=2..6 mm.
cases.mutation: Apply the shallow crossing slot. The 2 mm lower web keeps one connected solid while the top face splits.
acceptance: B-rep remains valid, contains one solid and has volume 5820 mm^3.
Both descendants retain source lineage and semantic_status=split.
The old single-face reference returns ambiguous, even when one descendant has much greater area.
No dependent feature executes using an arbitrary descendant.
cases.repair_policy: Highlight all descendants. Ask whether the operation applies to a specific supported region, both regions, or a datum; persist only a supported explicit intent.

tests.scope: Full-depth slot creates two solids and correctly marked split caps; complements the connected shallow-slot fixture.
Full real-kernel-to-resolver shallow-slot fixture: one solid, 5820 mm^3, two cap descendants, ambiguous reference and watertight mesh.

cases.title: Merged or unsupported provenance cannot masquerade as identity
cases.minimal_fixture: Two adjacent 20 x 30 x 5 mm solids with separate top-face ancestors; fuse and explicitly unify same-domain faces.
cases.mutation: Replace both ancestral faces with one coplanar merged descendant.
acceptance: The descendant records both source ancestors and semantic_status=merged.
A singular reference to either ancestor requires repair, even if there is only one result candidate.
Missing semantic_status, generated-only provenance and unknown provenance fail closed.
MVP does not claim real merge support until the fuse/unification fixture is implemented.
cases.repair_policy: Explain that multiple original regions became one. A whole-face selection is a new user intent, not implicit equivalence to either ancestor.

cases.title: Deleted face cannot silently bind to a replacement
cases.minimal_fixture: 40 x 30 x 5 mm plate; select side.x_min at x=0 mm.
cases.mutation: Trim using a box spanning x=-1..5, y=-1..31, z=-1..6 mm. The old side disappears and a cutter-generated side appears at x=5.
acceptance: Result is valid with volume 5250 mm^3.
Old side.x_min lineage is deleted; reference is missing.
A visually similar new side is at most a labeled proposal.
Reverting the trim restores the original semantic reference.
cases.repair_policy: Show the old intent and the new candidate side, with an explicit correction action. Never reuse the old name for a new cutter-generated face by geometric resemblance.

tests.scope: Real trimming deletes source-side lineage; trim width differs from the minimal specimen.
Full real-kernel-to-resolver deleted-side failure after bore and trim.

cases.title: Symmetry ties remain visible and unresolved
cases.minimal_fixture: Symmetric 40 x 30 x 5 mm plate with two equal radius-3 mm through-holes at (10,15) and (30,15). A missing central-hole intent is equidistant from both.
cases.mutation: Request repair using matching surface type, area and equal centroid distances.
acceptance: Both candidates have equal geometric evidence and tied_with_best=true.
Candidate display order is deterministic but never becomes a semantic tie-break.
No candidate is accepted, including a high-scoring unique geometric suggestion.
cases.repair_policy: Label the guesses and ask left/right or a new parametric relation. Store the chosen relation rather than an unqualified nearest-face rule.

cases.title: Bodies and topology kinds are separate scopes
cases.minimal_fixture: Two coincident body candidates with the same semantic role, plus an edge candidate whose role text matches a face.
cases.mutation: Resolve with an explicit body ID, then omit the body ID.
acceptance: An explicit body ID excludes candidates and geometric suggestions from another body.
An omitted body ID does not make duplicate semantic roles unambiguous.
Entity kind is required to match.
cases.repair_policy: Ask for body scope when necessary. Never infer the correct body from visibility or enumeration.

cases.title: Rollback and suppression cannot leak stale topology
cases.minimal_fixture: Profile -> pad -> hole, with saved references to the pad cap and generated hole wall.
cases.mutation: Rollback before hole; suppress hole; restore hole; rollback before pad; attempt a failed rebuild.
acceptance: References to absent features are missing while feature IDs and saved intents remain in the document.
Restoring an unchanged supported source restores its reference.
Only topology from the current successful evaluation participates in resolution.
A failed rebuild is reported as failure; a displayed last-good shape is labeled stale and cannot count as current geometry.
cases.repair_policy: Restore or unsuppress the source, or explicitly change the dependency. Never rebind to a face from a different history state.

tests.scope: Restoring the old source document reproduces original geometry; not feature suppression.
Failed dependency yields blocked result and no current active mesh.

cases.implementation_boundary: Suppression and interactive rollback-tip editing are not implemented. Old source-document replay and failure isolation are implemented; the resolver snapshot-absence unit test is not suppression integration coverage.

cases.title: Feature reorder respects dependencies and stable IDs
cases.minimal_fixture: Two independent profile/pad branches plus a cut that consumes one pad and a tool.
cases.mutation: Reorder source-list records without changing dependency edges, then attempt a dependency edit that introduces a cycle or missing input. Chronological operation reordering that intentionally rewires edges is a separate planned feature.
acceptance: Arbitrary source-list order preserves stable feature IDs and geometry because execution follows the dependency DAG.
Cyclic or missing dependency edits are rejected before publishing a new valid document state.
Failure preserves the prior valid source and reports the offending dependency.
Future operation-history reorder must show and validate any dependency rewiring; source-list sorting alone is not that capability.
cases.repair_policy: Explain the required dependency and reject cyclic or dangling references. Do not silently rewrite operation intent when reordering history.

tests.scope: Source-list permutation retains actual B-rep geometry.
Invalid dependency cycle rejected.
Missing feature dependency rejected.

cases.title: Display-unit changes do not alter physical geometry or identity
cases.minimal_fixture: Square profile with 25.4 mm sides and 2.54 mm extrusion; canonical internal units are mm.
cases.mutation: Express dimensions as 1 in and 0.1 in, then switch the display unit without editing dimensions.
acceptance: Equivalent unit inputs yield equal lengths, areas, volume and semantic references within documented tolerance.
Display-unit changes do not trigger an unintended model scaling.
Geometry suggestions reject explicitly noncanonical units; input conversion happens before scoring.
Dimensionally invalid expressions are rejected rather than coerced.
cases.repair_policy: Show the parsed physical value and unit at the input boundary; require a valid dimensional expression.

tests.scope: Unsupported source units rejected rather than silently coerced.

cases.implementation_boundary: The source schema currently accepts mm only and arithmetic has no dimensional type system. Blender scene-unit conversion is a separate display boundary; inch-bearing formulas and display-unit controls are planned.

cases.title: User corrections are explicit and auditable
cases.minimal_fixture: Missing saved cap reference with a similar stable cap on another feature in the same body.
cases.mutation: Show a geometric proposal; cancel; then explicitly accept a supported semantic replacement.
acceptance: Showing or canceling a proposal leaves the saved reference unchanged.
Acceptance stores the new semantic target and records the old target, candidate evidence and user decision.
Downstream recompute occurs only after accepted correction.
Snapshot-only generated faces are not falsely promised persistent identity.
cases.repair_policy: State the guess in plain language, highlight the candidate, and let the user choose a supported role or datum. Undo restores the prior saved intent.
cases.implementation_boundary: Resolver proposals are implemented. Persistent topology selections, repair-decision audit history, natural-language operation parsing and preview/confirm/undo UI are design requirements, not implemented features.

cases.title: One-to-one modified faces preserve supported source lineage
cases.minimal_fixture: 40 x 30 x 5 mm plate, selected top cap, cut by radius-3 mm through-cylinder at (12,15).
cases.mutation: Move the hole within the plate or change radius 3 to 4 mm without splitting the cap.
acceptance: B-rep is valid; volumes are 6000 - 45*pi then 6000 - 80*pi mm^3.
The cap has exactly one descendant and that descendant exactly one source ancestor.
The stable cap retains source feature UUID and semantic role, with cut operation ID and modified evolution recorded.
One-to-many or many-to-one ancestry must downgrade to split or merged instead.
cases.repair_policy: Keep the source role only when the supported operation proves one-to-one history; otherwise return explicit ambiguity.

tests.scope: Real through-hole dimensions, valid solid, retained cap role and one-to-one modified provenance.
Real modified cap resolves through the conservative resolver before a later trim.

cases.title: Exact repeated relations are explicit redundancy, not false inconsistency
cases.minimal_fixture: Constrained rectangle with initially unsolved endpoint seeds, H/V, coincidence, width/depth and anchor relations.
cases.mutation: Append an exact copy of a relation with a distinct stable ID; reverse symmetric point references; separately try near-equal distances and different fixed targets.
acceptance: Every saved constraint/ID remains unchanged; exact duplicates are omitted only from temporary native equations.
Successful solve reports redundant_okay, zero remaining DoF and duplicate IDs; all original residuals are independently checked.
Real extrusion retains exact analytic volume; distinct formulas equal now can correctly conflict after a later parameter edit.
Native failed IDs are diagnostic candidates, never proof that the user should delete the anchor.
Adding a lower-ID reversed coincidence duplicate does not translate the underconstrained seed solution.
cases.repair_policy: Applying an identical existing relation should be idempotent in future constraint tools. Explain redundancy; never silently delete saved relations or relax conflicting values.

cases.title: Only identity-connected supported closed regions become profiles
cases.minimal_fixture: Solved planar line records with stable point/line IDs and explicit coincidence constraints.
cases.mutation: Remove a boundary, branch an endpoint, add a second loop/hole, self-cross or place separate unjoined endpoints at identical coordinates.
acceptance: Only one closed non-self-intersecting line loop is accepted.
Endpoint sharing comes from stable IDs or explicit coincidence, never a nearest-point repair.
Unsupported linework fails with a structured profile error and blocked downstream solid.
cases.repair_policy: Keep source linework and identify the unsupported connectivity. Require explicit relations or profile selection before creating a solid.

cases.title: Stable sketch line IDs preserve extrusion side-face provenance
cases.minimal_fixture: Constrained 40 x 30 mm rectangle with stable line IDs, explicit plane and 10 mm extrusion.
cases.mutation: Change width to 60 mm, reorder serialized point/line/constraint records and feature source records; independently reverse polygon winding.
acceptance: Volume changes from 12000 to 18000 mm^3 with the same downstream feature ID.
Each side.line.<stable-ID> follows actual OCCT builder provenance, not list position.
Supported cap/side references resolve across dimension changes; plane-normal extrusion is explicit.
Rebuild does not rewrite saved seeds, expressions or source hashes.
cases.repair_policy: If a line disappears or construction provenance becomes split/merged, use the existing conservative missing/ambiguous repair policy.

cases.title: Schema migration is explicit and preserves legacy source hashes
cases.minimal_fixture: Delivered schema-1 drilled-plate and parameter-chain fixtures plus a typed constrained-sketch schema-2 fixture.
cases.mutation: Replay/serialize the legacy files, explicitly migrate a copy to schema 2, and attempt a constrained feature in unmigrated schema 1.
acceptance: Legacy schema-1 canonical bytes and historical hashes remain unchanged.
Explicit migration changes only schema version and preserves all feature IDs, labels, params, dependencies and active result.
Constrained features require schema 2 and a strict typed sketch payload; no automatic primitive conversion.
cases.repair_policy: Keep the old snapshot available. Reject unsupported new features until the user explicitly migrates the edit transaction.

cases.title: Input bounds are not promises of usable native geometry resolution
cases.minimal_fixture: 40 x 30 mm constrained rectangle extruded by 10 mm.
cases.mutation: Set width or depth to the documented inclusive input minimum 1e-6 mm.
acceptance: Unsupported extremely thin native profiles fail closed as degenerate_profile or kernel_error.
No current downstream mesh/shape is published; stored source remains available for correction.
Validation tolerances are not silently relaxed to force a result.
cases.repair_policy: Explain the native resolution/aspect-ratio limitation and require a physically usable feature size. Do not imply every value inside parser bounds is manufacturable.

cases.title: Explicit workplanes avoid ill-conditioned plane fitting
cases.minimal_fixture: Constrained 1e6 x 30 mm rectangle, 10 mm extrusion, origin (3,4,5), quaternion (2,-3,5,7)/sqrt(87).
cases.mutation: Scale the quaternion by sqrt(1+epsilon), epsilon in {0,+5e-10,-5e-10,+9.9e-10}, within the documented unit-norm acceptance tolerance.
acceptance: The temporary quaternion is normalized only for B-rep construction; persisted plane remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
The face uses the authoritative gp_Pln rather than fitting a plane from an ill-conditioned long thin wire.
All fixtures solve within residual tolerance and build valid solids of volume 3e8 mm^3.
cases.repair_policy: Reject truly invalid workplanes. Never rewrite the source orientation or loosen geometry checks to force a fit.

cases.title: Releasing a positional constraint preserves the current solved placement
cases.minimal_fixture: Viewport four-corner rectangle created 40 x 30 mm and extruded 10 mm. Edit width to 60 mm while preserving original authoring seeds.
cases.mutation: Explicitly turn Fix rectangle position off, Apply and Finish; then re-enable the anchor. Also cancel a validated release and save/reopen the released document.
acceptance: Removing only the anchor leaves the visible solved coordinates unchanged and changes real remaining DoF from 0 to 2.
Only this explicit position-constraint edit reseeds the same point IDs from the last validated solution. Ordinary dimension replay does not rewrite seeds.
Re-fixing pins the displayed current corner; downstream feature and entity IDs remain unchanged.
Cancel preserves the original canonical JSON byte-for-byte. Native Undo/Redo restores the corresponding constraint state and geometry.
cases.repair_policy: Do not replay stale creation seeds when the user only releases a positional relation. Simultaneous dimension edits can move a free sketch and require a fresh truthful preview.
supplementary_evidence: docs/UX.md: actual Blender 5.2.2 GUI release and Undo/Redo review

cases.title: A bounded editor rejects imported geometry branches it cannot preview truthfully
cases.minimal_fixture: Four same-ID rectangle corners with horizontal/vertical/distance constraints. Mirror X or Y seeds, or move the fixed anchor so a positive seed arrangement solves onto a negative branch.
cases.mutation: Open the imported sketch, Apply, or Finish directly without a prior Apply.
acceptance: Mirrored source definitions and unsupported solved orientation are explicitly rejected by the narrow +X/+Y rectangle editor.
Neither the preview nor a current DoF badge claims validation for an unsupported branch.
Finish performs one fresh guarded replay and validates orientation before any canonical mutation; source JSON and accepted downstream geometry remain intact.
cases.repair_policy: Keep the imported definition available for another supported editor or explicit correction. Never silently mirror geometry or relabel a corner to fit the overlay.
supplementary_evidence: tests/blender_viewport_sketch_smoke.py: native direct-Finish and changed-snapshot regressions
Independent native Blender5.2.2 audit: nine fixed/free/moved-anchor rejection cases

cases.title: Viewport schema-2 sources use authoritative canonical snapshot identity
cases.minimal_fixture: Exact GUI-authored 12 x 8 x 4 mm Part in examples/regressions/viewport_schema2_capture.mcad.json, including omitted optional constraint fields and expression dimensions.
cases.mutation: Capture into an assembly, reuse twice, save/reopen, change working width expression to 12 + 4, explicitly update every instance.
acceptance: Raw working editor JSON, feature/entity IDs, references, formulas and seeds remain unchanged by capture.
Canonical Document.to_json bytes define the accepted source digest; omitted defaults and record ordering never weaken identity checks.
Both instances update atomically; source hashes enter new report fingerprints and late pending responses are rejected.
cases.repair_policy: Request an authoritative snapshot receipt and preserve editor text. Reject forged receipts or changed revisions; never hash raw UI JSON as a substitute for canonical Part identity.
supplementary_evidence: tests/blender_assembly_schema2_capture.py: native fresh-process capture/reopen/edit/all-instance-update and pending-response rejection

cases.title: Owned CAD Focus does not slice a millimetre part with the near plane
cases.minimal_fixture: A 12 x 8 x 4 mm Part viewed in the CAD Part workspace with Blender default clip_start 0.01 scene units.
cases.mutation: Focus Result while orbiting the unchanged valid solid; repeat with unit scales and translated instances.
acceptance: Near plane is lowered from excessive settings using transformed local bounds and the native RNA floor.
Finer chosen settings, unrelated workspaces/viewports and Whole Scene remain unchanged.
Extreme tiny/far-origin native framing and clipping floors remain explicit limitations.
cases.repair_policy: Adjust only the owned CAD viewport on an explicit geometry Focus. Do not alter canonical dimensions or global user scene units to hide clipping.
supplementary_evidence: Native5.2.2 original GUI comparison established unchanged valid B-rep and near-plane cause; fixed GUI recheck remains separately qualified.

cases.title: Successful open sketch has no manufactured solid
cases.minimal_fixture: An independent two-line connected chain in embedded sketch schema 2.
cases.mutation: Add an extrusion consumer, then request check/STEP/STL export.
acceptance: The open sketch keeps successful solve and true DoF evidence, with no mesh/shape/volume.
The extrusion is blocked with profile_unavailable; active open export fails not_a_solid without replacing files.
cases.repair_policy: Keep the authored candidate recoverable; never substitute a stale solid or silently downgrade the response contract.

cases.title: Version negotiation prevents silent open-sketch downgrade
cases.minimal_fixture: Embedded sketch schema 2 circle or open chain, unchanged Part schema 2.
cases.mutation: Send legacy, supported new, and malformed result-version requests.
acceptance: Legacy clients get an explicit upgrade error for new capability data.
Solve-only cannot request file writes and binds all candidate input fields.
cases.repair_policy: Keep the authored candidate recoverable; never substitute a stale solid or silently downgrade the response contract.

cases.title: Successful output must consume current typed inputs
cases.minimal_fixture: Native circle solid and a separately solved open two-line chain.
cases.mutation: Substitute a structurally valid extrusion result into the open chain replay, keeping the exact request hash.
acceptance: An unavailable or failed profile cannot support a successful extrusion.
A matching request hash is necessary but cannot authorize contradictory evidence.
cases.repair_policy: Reject inconsistent evidence and keep the editable candidate; do not publish a successful geometry claim.

cases.title: Nested geometry and export evidence must be complete
cases.minimal_fixture: Native circle check and STEP/STL export responses.
cases.mutation: Corrupt check areas/counts/schema, remove export receipt, or alter output identity.
acceptance: Malformed nested reports fail before display/publication.
Completed export receipt binds destination, revision and encoded STL triangle size.
cases.repair_policy: Reject inconsistent evidence and keep the editable candidate; do not publish a successful geometry claim.

cases.title: Transport preserves source-bound ambiguous cut lineage
cases.minimal_fixture: A connected shallow slot followed by a bore, plus an analytic circle extrusion.
cases.mutation: Reverse source-list order, forge a missing boundary ID, or promote a split inherited cap to stable.
acceptance: Correct multi-cut lineage survives source-list reorder.
Missing source curves/tool faces and promoted ambiguity are rejected.
cases.repair_policy: Reject inconsistent evidence and keep the editable candidate; do not publish a successful geometry claim.

cases.title: Pruned draft history never reuses identities or overflows counters
cases.minimal_fixture: General circle/line draft with more than 64 local commands and deleted imported/generated IDs.
cases.mutation: Forge a retained add to reuse a pruned ID; restore maximum counters then attempt an edit.
acceptance: Restore rejects identity reuse after pruning and branching.
Counter exhaustion rejects before changing raw input, history, accepted intent or evidence.
cases.repair_policy: Retain the original saved bytes for explicit recovery or Discard; do not silently migrate old journal versions.

cases.title: Endpoint selection is explicit when curve and point occupy one pixel
cases.minimal_fixture: A line endpoint and its incident line project to the same pixel.
cases.mutation: Use generic Select, then explicit Points; add a distinct overlapping point.
acceptance: Generic selection retains the endpoint/curve ambiguity.
Point-only selection resolves only the curve tie, never two distinct point IDs.
cases.repair_policy: Use explicit point filtering or the selected curve’s named endpoint/center control.
cases.implementation_boundary: Pure/native contracts; interactive GUI and installed-package coverage are separate gates.

cases.title: Failed solve diagnostics never acquire current geometry authority
cases.minimal_fixture: A native failed sketch report with authored conflict candidate IDs.
cases.mutation: Change input A→B→A or the exact request/session/revision.
acceptance: Only exactly bound failed reports supply inspection candidates.
No failed diagnostic supplies solved geometry, DoF or publication authority.
cases.repair_policy: Retire observed stale diagnostics; use explicit fresh Check.
cases.implementation_boundary: Pure/native contracts; interactive GUI and installed-package coverage are separate gates.

cases.title: Conflict recovery preserves its explicit authored-position policy
cases.minimal_fixture: A general sketch with incompatible H/V or fixed relations and no current successful solution.
cases.mutation: Explicitly remove one named relation using authored seeds, then Undo/Redo and reopen.
acceptance: Only that relation is removed; geometry and surviving identities/expressions remain.
Ordinary solved release is not weakened or silently replaced.
Authored seeds remain exact and new solve evidence is required.
cases.repair_policy: Use the separately disclosed recovery command or local Undo; never choose a candidate automatically.
cases.implementation_boundary: Pure/native contracts; interactive GUI and installed-package coverage are separate gates.

cases.title: Ordinary Cut preserves exact tool wall ancestry
cases.minimal_fixture: Parametric cylinder through or partly into a rectangular pad, including reversed tool-face orientation.
cases.mutation: Edit radius/height; split the wall with a transverse slot; use a patterned or aliased tool; forge lineage evidence.
acceptance: One exact Modified/unchanged stable tool face remains selectable through edits.
Selected hole-edge blends rebuild as valid solids.
Split, patterned, aliased or forged tool lineage is not promoted.
cases.repair_policy: Fail closed when exact unique ancestry is unavailable; never nearest-face repair.
cases.implementation_boundary: Native and strict-client contracts only; GUI/installed-package exercise remains separate.

cases.title: Saved logical sketch plane survives a proven coplanar Cut split
cases.minimal_fixture: 20×20×10 mm block, shallow 2×22 slot and attached radius-2 sketch.
cases.mutation: Extend the slot through the top face, creating two equal coplanar descendants.
acceptance: Retain saved in-plane anchor, not a fragment centroid; downstream volume remains correct.
Keep native descendants split with snapshot-only IDs; do not invent face identity.
Persist versioned intent; save/replay and reordered snapshots produce the same plane.
Follow the original stable source workplane through width/position/normal changes; different planes or missing source ancestry require correction.
Keep a nonzero saved source-relative anchor continuous through asymmetric single Modified face, split, and unsplit; distinguish exact face identity from assumed placement policy.
cases.repair_policy: Preserve the common logical plane only under saved preserve_plane intent; otherwise choose a current stable support explicitly. See docs/regressions/topology/support/MCAD-TNP-SUPPORT-001.md.

tests.scope: Native split/tilt/source-frame transport/refusal, save/replay, downstream geometry and client result binding.
Bounded persisted intent and native-free mirror equality.
Native registered review with dialog/layout harness, atomic correction, Cancel, stale evidence, .blend create and independent reopen; not mouse/Undo qualification.

cases.title: Selected blend surface owns exact generated identity
cases.minimal_fixture: Selected box-edge chamfer and circular cylinder fillet.
cases.mutation: Change profile size and blend size; save and reopen.
acceptance: Native unique construction provenance remains stable through parameter edits.
Ambiguous source or image history is not promoted.
Planar sketch and supported edge references replay after persistence; curved surfaces remain nonplanar.
cases.repair_policy: Edit the owning feature to change authored construction intent; ambiguous history remains unresolved. See docs/regressions/topology/blend/MCAD-TNP-BLEND-001.md.

tests.scope: Native construction, dimensions, edit/save/replay and ambiguity/transport rejection.
Registered operators, face resolution, sketch, parameter edit and independent .blend reopen; no interactive mouse qualification.

cases.title: Open Shell inner wall and lip own exact native construction
cases.minimal_fixture: 20×15×10 open enclosure and cylindrical cup.
cases.mutation: Change wall thickness and base size; deliberately change the selected opening; save and reopen.
acceptance: Native unique construction provenance remains stable through parameter edits.
Ambiguous source or image history is not promoted.
Planar sketch and supported edge references replay after persistence; curved surfaces remain nonplanar.
The explicit current-opening lip intent follows deliberate opening edits, while inner-wall identities remain source-bound.
cases.repair_policy: Edit the owning feature to change authored construction intent; ambiguous history remains unresolved. See docs/regressions/topology/shell/MCAD-TNP-SHELL-001.md.

tests.scope: Native construction, dimensions, edit/save/replay and ambiguity/transport rejection.
Registered operators, face resolution, sketch, parameter edit and independent .blend reopen; no interactive mouse qualification.

cases.title: Saved minimal-twist support frame crosses the projected-world-axis threshold
cases.minimal_fixture: Asymmetric 6×4 sketch with source/local offsets on source plane rotated 64 degrees about Y.
cases.mutation: Rotate source through 64.3,65,90,110 degrees and back, including Cut split; test antiparallel baseline.
acceptance: Saved tangent transports deterministically across the old normal.x threshold without inferring material spin.
Saved/replayed geometry and client world-plane validation agree.
Omitted orientation and Strict preserve existing behavior.
Antiparallel/degenerate cases refuse with deliberate World axes/reset correction.
cases.repair_policy: Explicit Orientation or Reset saved frame here, warning of rotation/movement; no hidden axis fallback.

tests.scope: Threshold/normal changes, asymmetric geometry, persistence, antiparallel/reset and independent client frame validation.
Bounded tangent record and core/client mirror equality.
Bounded native registered review/Cancel/legacy/orientation/reset/Strict/stale evidence and independent .blend reopen; not mouse/Undo qualification.

cases.title: Feature-owned authored hole-pattern occurrence surfaces
cases.minimal_fixture: Separate cylindrical tools cut a plate; blind floors support an attached sketch.
cases.mutation: Edit size, pitch, count and sweep; remove/overlap/split a referenced occurrence; save and replay.
acceptance: Numbered authored placement plus stable source tool face owns only one exact native image.
Count or sweep changes may move the same occurrence, never nearest-hole rebind.
Missing, split, overlapping or competing histories stay snapshot-only; downstream references fail closed.
Legacy result v1 is unchanged and native-free clients reject forged source/count/hash evidence.
cases.repair_policy: Edit Pattern placement/count or explicitly replace the reference; no collective overlap naming.

tests.scope: Native occurrence provenance, edits/save/replay, downstream references, refusal/forgery cases and labels; no interactive GUI qualification.

cases.title: Source-bound logical workplanes survive complete successive Cut ancestry
cases.minimal_fixture: 20 x 20 x 10 mm block, two or three 2 mm top slots, and an attached radius-2 sketch.
cases.mutation: Edit width/depth, delete some/all fragments, alter source ancestry, save/reopen and replay in a fresh process.
acceptance: Compose complete native Modified/unchanged/deleted evidence through ordinary Cut base chains only.
Retain the saved source-relative anchor without fragment selection or identity promotion.
Permit proven partial deletion; reject complete disappearance, competing/generated origins, aliases and noncoplanarity.
Persist only the authored source feature and signatures, never snapshot IDs or native ledgers.
Independent v2/v3 replay and solve clients bind every ledger to current input/output catalogs; legacy unbound intent remains unchanged.
cases.repair_policy: Use existing Review Support, Strict, another stable support or explicit frame reset; no guessed replacement face.

tests.scope: Exact native source/claim completeness, splits/deletion, competing relations, catalog and request-local handle guards.
Two/three Cuts, exact geometry, edits/removal, fresh-process persistence, independent clients, forgery refusal and review helper corrections.
Bounded authored source binding, missing-context refusal and native-free mirror equality.

cases.implementation_boundary: Native and pure authoring/transport tests; no interactive GUI, installed-package or universal TNP claim.

cases.title: Explicit staged Up to Face end-reference correction
cases.minimal_fixture: Block with shallow slot and two Up to Face consumers; an earlier translated solid retains the same semantic face ID.
cases.mutation: Deepen slot to split or remove target, explicitly replace end targets, retain partial repairs, Save/Resume/Undo and freshly replay.
acceptance: Only known target gates classify as repairable; unexpected native/profile/offset failures remain failures.
Choose an earlier dependency-safe solid and stable parallel plane explicitly, preserving profile/direction/offset types and formulas.
Keep accepted state unchanged until full replay; partial corrections and original-branch eligibility survive intent-only Save/Resume/Undo.
Never persist native tokens/snapshots or choose by proximity; unrelated branches and malformed transitions reject.
cases.repair_policy: Replace End Face on the retained proposal; no automatic target or face selection. Cancel keeps work, Discard abandons it.

tests.scope: Native split/deletion, exact geometry and precise target error classification.
Current native geometry, profile frames, explicit catalog choices and v2/v3 clients.
Bounded transitions, partial chains, stale ownership, intent codec and fresh Resume.

cases.implementation_boundary: Source/native and background Blender evidence; actual GUI and installed package qualification remain separate.
